// FIXTURE — NE PAS COMPILER (extension .go.txt).
//
// CONTRE-EXEMPLE : les formes CONFORMES qui interrogent legitimement `xuid`.
// Le detecteur doit rester TOTALEMENT muet dessus, faute de quoi le garde-rail
// serait ingerable et finirait desactive.
//
// 1. Provider LIE au joueur (forme livree le 2026-07-26) : aucun parametre
//    d identite, le xuid vient du champ fige a la construction.
// 2. Agregat population : requete `xuid` sans aucun parametre d identite.
// 3. Provider d escouade : l identite passe par un `rosterXUIDs []string` —
//    des xuids explicitement nommes comme tels, jamais un slug.
package prestige

func (p *HaloBaselineProvider) RecentMatches(ctx context.Context, _, metric string, window int) ([]prestige.MatchData, error) {
	col := mapMetricToColumn(metric)
	q := fmt.Sprintf(`
		SELECT mp.match_id, mr.start_time, %s
		FROM match_participants mp
		JOIN match_registry mr ON mr.match_id = mp.match_id
		WHERE mp.xuid = ?
		ORDER BY mr.start_time DESC
		LIMIT ?
	`, col)
	return queryMatches(ctx, p.reader, q, p.xuid, window)
}

// 1bis. Somme cumulative bornee par une DATE (livree le 2026-07-26) : le seul
//       parametre non-metier est un `since time.Time`, pas une identite.
func (p *HaloBaselineProvider) CumulativeSince(ctx context.Context, _, metric string, since time.Time) (float64, int, error) {
	q := fmt.Sprintf(`
		SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(%s AS DOUBLE)), 0), COUNT(*)
		FROM match_participants mp
		JOIN match_registry mr ON mr.match_id = mp.match_id
		WHERE mp.xuid = ? AND mr.start_time >= ?
	`, mapMetricToColumn(metric))
	return queryTotal(ctx, p.reader, q, p.xuid, since)
}

func (p *HaloBaselineProvider) PopulationPercentile(ctx context.Context, _ string, metric string, target float64) (float64, int, error) {
	q := fmt.Sprintf(`
		SELECT mp.xuid, AVG(%s) AS avg_metric
		FROM match_participants mp
		GROUP BY mp.xuid
	`, mapMetricToColumn(metric))
	return aggregate(ctx, p.reader, q, target)
}

func (p *PrestigeSquadMatchProvider) SquadMatchMetrics(ctx context.Context, rosterXUIDs []string, titleSlug, metric string, limit int) ([]prestige.SquadMatchMetric, error) {
	q := fmt.Sprintf(`
		SELECT mp.match_id, mp.xuid, %s
		FROM match_participants mp
		WHERE mp.xuid IN (%s)
		HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT mp.xuid) = %d
	`, metric, placeholders(len(rosterXUIDs)), len(rosterXUIDs))
	return queryRoster(ctx, p.reader, q, rosterXUIDs, limit)
}

func (r *PrestigeSquadRepo) RemoveMember(ctx context.Context, squadID, xuid string) error {
	return execCheckpointed(ctx, r.db,
		`INSERT INTO squad_member_history (squad_id, xuid, is_member, joined_at)
		 VALUES (?, ?, FALSE, NULL)`, squadID, xuid)
}

func (r *PrestigeArcRepo) ListByUser(ctx context.Context, userID, titleSlug string) ([]prestige.Arc, error) {
	return queryArcs(ctx, r.db,
		`SELECT id, user_id, title_slug FROM arc WHERE user_id = ? AND title_slug = ?`,
		userID, titleSlug)
}
